title: 第61章 危险来临，王乃香舍身相救
content_zh:
第61章 危险来临，王乃香舍身相救-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“娘，这狗东西不打他一顿，不知道长记性，竟然还敢来我家骂街，谁给你的胆子？”

李青山说着，又是一巴掌狠狠对着赵瞎子抽了过去。

顿时。

原本就已经被抽的红肿的嘴巴，再次迎来重击，忍不住发出一声痛苦和哀嚎的声音。

“青山，别打了，这再打下去就出事了。”李三奎也从人群中走了出来，配合着自己的婆娘一起，将李青山拉了回来，只留下赵瞎子躺在地上，哎呦哎呦的惨叫。

“李财叔，这件事情还得你帮忙了，家中的板车借用一下，我们这就去乡里将肉全都赶紧处理了。”

李青山开口道。

“行，没问题！”

“大壮，你回家一趟，将板车拉过来！”

李财点头道。

“各位叔叔大爷上山帮忙也辛苦了，我李青山别的不多，但是家里的野猪肉倒是不少！”

“来，只要是今天上山帮忙的。”

“一个人两斤肉，拎回家今天晚上吃顿好的。”

李青山说罢，朝着赵红旗看了一眼道：“红旗，你来分肉，一个人两斤肉！”

“好嘞！”

赵红旗连忙点头应下，拎起旁边的刀子便开始割肉给帮忙的人分割。

今天上山了二十七个人。

一个人两斤肉，也就是六毛多钱，对于李青山来说不多，也就是一只野兔子，但是对于这些上山帮忙的叔叔大爷来说，这二斤肉可不少啊！

上一次吃肉，还是过年呢！

一家子，也就割一斤肉，要是人口多的话，倒是还能割两斤回来。

一个个都馋了大半年了。

最关键的是。

他们早晨才刚刚喝过肉汤吃过肉，现在又能拎着两斤野猪肉回家打打牙祭，犒劳犒劳老婆和孩子，那今天晚上，媳妇还不得多些花样了。

“青山，叔果然没看错你，就是大气啊！”

“我一看就知道，青山以后是做大事情的人，哈哈……！”

“哎呦，今天晚上我家婆娘说什么也得好好犒劳犒劳老子了。”

“青山，谢了啊1！”

跟着李青山一起上山的叔叔大爷们，眼前顿时一亮，连忙开口道。

"Mom, this bitch dares to come to my house and scold me if I don't give him a good beating or long memory. Who gave you the courage?"

Li Qingshan said, and slapped Blind Zhao hard again.

Suddenly.

His mouth, which was already red and swollen from being slapped, was hit hard again, and he couldn't help but let out a sound of pain and wailing.

"Qingshan, stop fighting. If you continue to fight, something will happen." Li Sankui also walked out of the crowd and cooperated with his mother-in-law to pull Li Qingshan back, leaving only Blind Zhao lying on the ground, screaming.

"Uncle Li Cai, I need your help with this matter. Let's borrow the cart at home. We'll go to the countryside and process all the meat quickly."

Li Qingshan said.

"Okay, no problem!"

"Dazhuang, go home and pull the cart over!"

Li Cai nodded.

"It's hard work for all the uncles and uncles who went up to the mountain to help. I, Li Qingshan, don't have much else, but I do have a lot of wild boar meat at home!"

"Come on, as long as you come up the mountain to help today."

"Two pounds of meat per person, take it home and have a good meal tonight."

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he glanced at Zhao Hongqi and said, "Hongqi, come and divide the meat, two pounds of meat per person!"

"Okay!"

Zhao Hongqi nodded quickly in agreement, picked up the knife next to him, and began to cut the meat into pieces for the helpers.

Twenty-seven people went up the mountain today.

Two kilograms of meat per person, which is more than 60 cents, is not much for Li Qingshan, which is just a wild rabbit, but for these uncles and uncles who come to the mountain to help, these two kilograms of meat are a lot!

The last time I ate meat was during the Chinese New Year!

A family can only cut one catty of meat, but if the population is large, they can get back two catties.

Everyone has been craving it for more than half a year.

The most important thing is.

They had just drank broth and eaten meat in the morning, and now they could carry two kilograms of wild boar meat home to make tooth sacrifices to reward their wives and children. So tonight, the wife would have to do more tricks.

"Qingshan, I saw you right, you are so grand!"

"I can tell at a glance that Qingshan will do big things in the future, haha...!"

"Hey, my mother-in-law said she has to reward me tonight."

"Qingshan, thank you!"

The eyes of the uncles and uncles who followed Li Qingshan up the mountain suddenly lit up and they spoke quickly.
